Name: Coastal Fishery
Author: Aufhcegak
Description:
[b]PC 0.2.4 - the workstation page can no longer trap you (2026-10-22)[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed the workstation page getting stuck: opening it could leave the page impossible to close and impossible to quit, Esc did nothing, and the only way out was killing the game.
[*]Every exit path (close button, second close, Esc, controller B/Back, and the page's own invalid-state check) now goes through one fallback that also works when the page is buried under another menu or dialogue.
[*]A per-frame watchdog force-closes the page on a real Esc/B even if the window lost focus or an overlay swallowed the input, and a late "return to station" callback can no longer reopen it.
[*]Unchanged: closing the inventory still returns to the workstation stock page, closing that leaves the scene, and harvesting, rebaiting, sorting rules and Bait Mill progress are untouched.
[/list]

[b]电脑版0.2.4：工作站页不会再卡住[/b]

[list]
[*]修复打开工作站后关不掉、退出不了、ESC无效、只能强杀游戏的问题。
[*]关闭按钮、再按一次关闭、ESC、手柄B/Back、界面失效检测现在都走同一个兜底出口，即使页面被别的菜单或对话压住也能真正关闭。
[*]新增每帧看门狗：窗口失焦或被覆盖层吞掉输入时，真实ESC/B仍会强制关闭；关闭后15帧内不会被迟到的返回请求重新打开。
[*]保持不变：库存点关闭回工作站库存页，再关即退出场景；收笼、补饵、分拣规则和制饵进度都不受影响。
[/list]

[b]PC 0.2.2 — rebaiting and readable menus[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed crab pots not receiving bait after the workstation inventory was closed. Collection and rebaiting now continue while the management page is open; editing the actual inventory pauses the station, and closing it resumes work.
[*]Hold bait and use the workstation to deposit it. If storage has limited room, the remaining bait stays in your backpack.
[*]Menu text now uses native font sizes. Long labels wrap, buttons adapt, and small windows have scrollable pages with fixed Inventory and Close controls.
[/list]

[b]Install / update[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.1+. Download the PC main file, extract the CoastalFishery folder into Mods, replace the previous version, then restart SMAPI. Existing workstations, 70-slot inventory, sorting settings and Bait Mill progress are retained. No extra mod dependency is required. The main download is the PC build.

[b]电脑版0.2.2：补饵与界面修复[/b]

[list]
[*]修复关闭工作站库存后，工作台有鱼饵但蟹笼不补饵的问题。打开管理页时继续收笼补饵；实际整理库存时暂停，关闭后恢复。
[*]手拿鱼饵使用工作台即可存入，空间不足时剩余鱼饵仍留在背包。
[*]正文、按钮和物品名改用原版自然字号；长文字换行、按钮自适应，短窗口正文可滚动，库存和关闭按钮固定可用。
[/list]

[b]安装与更新[/b]
需要星露谷1.6与SMAPI4.5.1以上。下载PC主文件，把CoastalFishery文件夹放入Mods并替换旧版，再重启SMAPI。已有工作站、70格库存、分拣设置和制饵进度保留，无需重新制作。没有额外模组前置。主下载为电脑版。

[b]About Coastal Fishery[/b]

One coastal workstation collects and rebaits your crab pots across the current map. Manage a shared 70-slot inventory, keep per-species reserves, withdraw surplus to sell, and turn ordinary surplus catches into bait with an installed Bait Mill. English and Chinese.

Fixes the workstation page that could not be closed (Esc did nothing, the game had to be killed). Version 0.2.4, Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.5.1 or newer. No extra dependency.

电脑版 0.2.4：修复工作站页关不掉、ESC无效、只能强杀游戏的问题。包含中英文游戏内文本，需要星露谷1.6与SMAPI4.5.1以上，无额外前置。
